---
name: Evidence or correction
about: Add evidence that changes a technical or business assumption.
title: "[Evidence] "
---

## Claim or assumption to improve

Link the affected file, section or backlog ID. State the current claim and the proposed correction.

## Evidence

Provide the primary source URL, publisher, publication/update date, access date and the precise claim supported. For costs, include currency, price year and project scope. Separate the source's statement from your inference.

## Effect on the plan

What product, budget, timeline or decision changes? What remains uncertain?

## Rights and limits

Confirm you may publish the contribution. Note any unavailable evidence, permission limits or conflicting sources. Link to third-party material instead of uploading restricted documents.

## Suggested next action

State a bounded deliverable and the owner role needed. Volunteering is welcome; no assignment is implied.
